theme: Last day at sea before the trip turns homeward.
greeting: Your final full day on the Adriatic, Dan. Tomorrow the charter ends at Komolac and the long route home to Tampa begins — a few arrival details are still loose.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat transfers still open
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends at Komolac around noon tomorrow. The transfer to Cavtat, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and a pre-dawn checkout for Sunday's flight are all still unbooked.

needsAttention.title: TPA rental car not booked yet
needsAttention.detail: You land Tampa Sunday at 3:55 PM and need the Sept 20 – Oct 5 full-size SUV booked before then — the alternative is a walk-up rate, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

needsAttention.title: St Pete nights Sept 20-21 unbooked
needsAttention.detail: You land Sunday but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday. The two nights in St Pete before the Orlando villa still need a room.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message from Claudia Kruse
flagged.detail: A note from Claudia Kruse has been sitting in your LinkedIn messages for a few days.

inbox.noise: Otherwise it's newsletters and retail — Alison Roman, Field Company, a Duke tailgate, an Evite.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Autumn's squash and warm spices are at their peak now.

acts.line: The final morning of the charter — open water, and nothing on the calendar.
A quiet stretch offline; the day stays clear straight through.
Last night aboard before disembarking at Komolac around noon tomorrow.
